label: Nothing stands unvouched for
description: Data graph behind customer.listRaw where the customers are kept rather than fetched: a store holds only what this tree wrote, and this tree writes whole customers, so nothing predates what a customer means here. It reads no store and answers an empty walk, which is what makes the backfill a step every profile can run and only one profile does work in.

nothing.description: the empty walk: a store has nothing that predates what a customer means here
